common:lock: Action that locks wallet access. Keep separate from Logout, which ends the current wallet session.
common:logout: Action that ends the wallet session. Preserve the distinction from Lock.
common:wallets: Navigation to the account inventory. An account has one address; a wallet can hold several accounts.
common:mainnet: Production network label. Translate together with testnet using GLOSSARY.md.
common:testnet: Testing network label. Translate together with mainnet using GLOSSARY.md.
common:mainnetBadge: Compact main network badge, uppercase where the script has case. Use the same term as mainnet.
common:testnetBadge: Compact test network badge, uppercase where the script has case. Use the same term as testnet.
common:mainnetFull: Built-in full network display name. Preserve QRL 2.0 and translate Mainnet consistently.
common:testnetFull: Built-in full network display name. Preserve QRL 2.0 and translate Testnet consistently.
common:testnetV3: Built-in private v3 network display name. Preserve QRL and v3; Private describes this network's deployment scope.
common:connectedDapps: Count of paired decentralized applications. {{count}} is an integer; supply the catalog's plural forms.
common:qrlAddress: Accessible label. {{address}} is the complete Q-prefixed account address and must remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
common:pinDigit: Accessible label for one PIN entry box. {{position}} is its one-based position.
home:setupLocal: Local account setup. A new account generates a seed; importing restores an existing seed.
home:setupWeb: Browser setup with local accounts, browser extension signing, or mobile signing. Preserve all listed options.
home:pairingFailed: Pairing failed before a mobile session could start. {{reason}} is a verbatim service error. Keep it in the sentence.
home:installMobile: App discovery hint. {{url}} is the supplied app-store URL. Preserve it exactly and retain the alternative scan action.
home:pairingHint: The phone signs requests for this browser session. Scanning pairs the devices; keep the signing role explicit.
home:pairingKeyExchange: Pairing status during cryptographic key exchange. English preserves the SDK token key_exchange for compatibility.
home:mobileUnresponsive: The phone did not answer. Preserve the instruction to open MyQRLWallet and retry.
home:mobileUnqualified: The app lacks the required Testnet v3 signing capability. Preserve the update and pair-again actions.
home:receiveHint: The address and QR code receive public funds. Quanta is the asset name and stays unchanged.
home:hideNft: Hides an NFT from this wallet's view. Ownership remains on chain.
home:items: Number of NFT items within one collection. {{count}} is an integer.
home:collections: Number of NFT collections, grouped by contract. {{count}} counts collections.
home:foundCollections: Explorer-reported ownership awaiting review. {{count}} counts collections. Preserve the <count> tag around the emphasized number.
settings:languageError: A language selection could not be saved or loaded. A saved choice survives download failure for a later attempt.
settings:changePinHint: The wallet PIN encrypts locally held seeds. Keep PIN and seed as distinct concepts.
settings:pinFormat: Validation rule: exactly 4 to 6 digits. Preserve both limits and the digit-only constraint.
settings:pinMatch: The new PIN and confirmation must match each other.
settings:pinDifferent: The new PIN must differ from the current PIN.
settings:attemptsLeft: Remaining PIN verification attempts. {{count}} is an integer; preserve each plural form.
settings:beforeLockout: Remaining attempts before a temporary security lockout. {{count}} is an integer.
settings:incorrectPin: Failed PIN verification with {{count}} attempts remaining. Never omit the count or the failure.
settings:lockout: Temporary lockout following failed PIN checks. {{count}} is the wait rounded up to whole minutes.
settings:pinBusy: Another PIN verification is running. Retrying is safe after it finishes.
settings:credentialPin: The device security credential needed for the seed is unavailable. Re-importing is required before changing the PIN.
settings:pinBackupFailed: A native seed backup failed and the old PIN remains active. Preserve both facts.
settings:pinError: Generic PIN rotation failure. This wording intentionally matches the existing wallet, including unconfirmed rollback failures.
settings:autoLockHint: Inactivity limit in minutes. Existing security preference lifetime and validation are unchanged.
settings:exportDescription: Export of the active account. <account> wraps the account address component or the fallback words the active account. Keep the component at the grammatical account position. The PIN unlocks the seed; a separate strong password encrypts the exported file.
settings:exportNoSeed: This device lacks a PIN-encrypted seed for this account. Extension accounts must be exported from the extension.
settings:exportOldFormat: Stored seed format is unsupported for export. Preserve the required re-import action.
settings:credentialExport: The device security credential is unavailable. Re-importing the seed restores access.
settings:seedMismatch: Security failure: the stored seed derives a different account address. Preserve the re-import instruction and block on export.
settings:filePassword: Password for the exported wallet file. It is distinct from the wallet PIN.
settings:passwordFormat: File-password validation requires at least 8 characters, including uppercase, lowercase, a number, and a special character. Preserve every condition.
settings:passwordHint: File-password guidance. Preserve the minimum length and all four required character categories.
settings:exportShared: The encrypted file was handed to the native share sheet. The user still needs to save it safely.
settings:exportDownloaded: Encrypted file download completed. Preserve the safe-storage instruction.
settings:sessionsHint: QRL Connect uses an end-to-end encrypted relay. Preserve the scope of the encryption claim.
settings:offline: A stored pairing has no current socket and will retry later. Preserve the retry meaning.
settings:disconnect: Ends this paired dApp session. Does not revoke previously signed on-chain approvals.
tokens:hide: Removes a token from this wallet's displayed list. It does not transfer or burn tokens.
tokens:discoveredHint: Explorer discovery proposes tokens for user review. Preserve the instruction to choose trusted tokens.
tokens:found: Explorer-reported token discovery count awaiting review. {{count}} is an integer. Preserve the <count> tag around the emphasized number.
tokens:addReason: Single-token persistence failure. {{reason}} is the verbatim error text and must remain visible.
tokens:addPicksReason: Failure adding selected discovered tokens. {{reason}} is the verbatim error text and must remain visible.
tokens:fetchReason: Token metadata lookup failed. {{reason}} is the verbatim error text; preserve it and QRC-20.
history:pending: A transaction has not yet reached confirmed inclusion. Preserve this distinction from confirmed.
history:dropped: A transaction failed because it was dropped or replaced. Preserve both possible causes.
history:storageError: History persistence failed. Preserve the instruction to keep this page open until confirmation.
accounts:balance: The balance is already formatted by the wallet. Preserve Quanta and the value exactly; translate the whole label.
accounts:limit: Wallet count divided by the maximum wallet count, not a fraction of funds. Keep both values and parentheses.
accounts:disconnectMobile: Ends the paired phone relay session and removes that mobile account from this wallet. This action is distinct from switching accounts.
accounts:scanCopy: The full public account address is shown here. Scanning or copying this address does not export a seed.
contacts:deleteDescription: Removes only this saved recipient from the address book. The name is user input and the address is an already formatted public address; preserve both placeholders.
contacts:invalidAddress: Q followed by exactly 128 hexadecimal characters is the supported QIP-55 address format. Keep the prefix and length unchanged.
contacts:serviceError: Unknown storage/service error data. Preserve the reason verbatim, including technical detail.
contacts:namePlaceholder: Example label for a contact that represents a wallet kept offline. Cold storage is not a server storage tier.
transfer:available: The balance component contains the existing numeric and asset formatter. Keep the self-closing balance tag and translate the full message.
transfer:decimals: Maximum supported fractional digits for this asset. The count selects cardinal plurals; digits preserves the original display value. English deliberately retains the original plural wording even at one.
transfer:recipientChanged: Signing is blocked after the resolved address or its network/account binding changes. Tell the user to verify the recipient again before signing.
transfer:seedMismatch: Security failure: the decrypted seed derives a different sender account. Require re-import of this account; never suggest bypassing the check.
transfer:invalidSeed: PIN decryption succeeded but the resulting seed does not match the sender. Preserve the security meaning without implying the transfer succeeded.
transfer:credentialUnavailable: The original device security credential is needed. Preserve both recovery alternatives and the reference to the original device.
transfer:pinHint: The PIN encrypts the wallet seed. This field is hidden when a remote signer or the unlocked desktop signer owns signing.
transfer:approveMobile: Approval happens in MyQRLWallet on the paired phone. Do not imply that approval or broadcast has already happened.
transfer:approveDesktop: Approval happens in the separate desktop signer. Do not imply that the web renderer signs or that a transaction is confirmed.
transfer:approveExtension: Approval happens in the browser extension. Keep MyQRLWallet unchanged.
transfer:broadcast: Signed and broadcast means sent to the network and awaiting block inclusion. It does not establish confirmation or finality.
transfer:stillWaiting: A signed transaction has been broadcast but confirmation is still unknown. Preserve the full distinction to avoid duplicate sends.
transfer:checkSigner: Returning to the form does not cancel a request already sent to a signer. Keep both signer and History checks before sending again.
transfer:confirmationTimeout: Five minutes is the existing wait threshold. Confirmation may still happen; keep the History/explorer check before another send.
transfer:confirmationUnavailable: The reason is service error data. Keep its details and the instruction to check History or the explorer before sending again.
transfer:transactionFailed: The reason is a complete service error. Preserve its details; built-in seed and wallet errors are localized at the presentation boundary.
transfer:transferFailed: The reason is a complete error, possibly supplied by the signer. Preserve external text exactly, including punctuation.
transfer:reverted: Execution was reverted. Keep the external reason and avoid wording that implies the recipient received funds.
transfer:networkFee: The cost paid to the blockchain network, denominated in Quanta. Gas measures execution work; this label describes its monetary cost.
transfer:maxQuote: Maximum send requires a current quote bound to this recipient. Manual entry remains possible; do not imply fee-free sending.
transfer:manualMobile: The paired phone calculates its own fee. This explanation must retain the manual-amount instruction.
transfer:nameResolved: Name resolution supplies an address. It does not verify ownership or authorize a payment. Keep the QNS name as data.
transfer:nameChainMismatch: QRNS is unavailable because the RPC chain identity differs from the configured network. Keep the network name as supplied data.
transfer:nameGenesisMismatch: QRNS is unavailable because the genesis block identity differs. Do not collapse this into a generic lookup failure.
transfer:recipientHintNative: Complete instruction including the QR option available in the native app. Keep separate from the web instruction.
history:amountUnit: The unit is Quanta or unmodified external token metadata. Preserve it and the existing amount formatter.
history:feesDetail: Fees paid by this transaction. Missing values remain unavailable, never zero.
history:statusDetail: The following value is a transaction outcome. Pending, confirmed, failed and dropped have distinct meanings.

Only after removal completes import each wallet with its recovery backup. Preserve all conditions, steps and consequences.

onboarding:nativeStorageUnconfirmed: The device credential request timed out without confirmation of secure wallet storage. Preserve BOTH instructions: update the app, then try again. Do not claim storage succeeded, a credential was replaced, or wallet data was removed.
onboarding:nativeSeedBackupFailed: The native app rejected the encrypted seed backup. The web copy may already be stored. Describe only the native secure seed backup failure; do not imply successful backup, rollback, deletion or PIN failure.
onboarding:nativeSeedBackupMismatch: Native acknowledgement did not match the requested encrypted-seed revision or ciphertext hash. Preserve the different-revision meaning; do not claim the requested backup succeeded.
onboarding:nativeSeedBackupUnavailable: The native secure seed backup service is unavailable. Preserve the native owner and seed-backup scope; this does not describe the browser copy.
onboarding:nativeSeedRevisionInvalid: Native backup requires a valid encrypted-seed revision number. Revision refers to the stored envelope, not an app version or recovery word.
onboarding:nativeSeedBackupUnconfirmed: The seed backup acknowledgement timed out. Preserve the lack of native confirmation. The web copy may already be stored; do not imply success, rollback or deletion.
onboarding:nativeBridgeUnavailable: The renderer cannot send the credential or seed-backup request through the native wallet bridge. Preserve the communication failure, without implying storage succeeded.
onboarding:nativeCredentialFailed: Wallet-owned fallback for a native device credential error. Credential is the independent device security factor, not the PIN, wallet-file password or recovery phrase.
onboarding:nativeCredentialResponseInval: The native device credential response has an invalid shape. Preserve the response failure; do not describe an incorrect PIN or missing recovery phrase.
onboarding:nativeStorageUnavailable: The native secure storage service is unavailable. Preserve its native owner and distinguish this from browser storage.
onboarding:nativeCredentialCandidateInva: The proposed random device credential is invalid before storage is requested. Candidate refers to the independent device security factor, not a user-entered PIN or password.
onboarding:storedValueInvalid: A stored wallet value failed its shape check. Preserve the invalid-data meaning. Do not suggest replacing or clearing it; the storage guard preserves it for recovery.
onboarding:activeAccountInvalid: Account activation rejected an invalid address. Preserve the QIP-55 identifier and the active-account scope.
onboarding:accountListInvalid: Saving the account inventory rejected an invalid entry. Preserve the QIP-55 identifier and account-list scope.
onboarding:desktopBridgeUnavailable: The renderer-owned desktop bridge guard failed during creation or import. Preserve window.qrlWallet as a technical identifier. This is separate from an error supplied verbatim by the external signer.
onboarding:typeErrorReason: TypeError wrapper for a wallet-owned storage failure. The reason is translated separately at display time. Unknown external errors retain their complete original text.
onboarding:storedArrayExpected: A wallet-owned array guard rejected stored token inventory while activating the created or imported account. Preserve the type requirement; do not imply the wallet data was cleared.
onboarding:storedStringExpected: A wallet-owned string guard rejected a stored seed address during persistence. Preserve the type requirement; do not imply seed deletion or an incorrect PIN.
onboarding:storedTokenListInvalid: The wallet rejected malformed stored token inventory during account activation after creation or import. Keep the token-list scope, without implying the seed or credential is invalid.
